description: Elections Commission - S. S. Hettiarachchi and E. D. I. S Padmaseeli of the Seethawaka Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his office of the Members of the United National Party
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the vacation of office by members of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This is a notice issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by a Returning Officer, making it directly related to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
